interpretation.headline: 16/16 tranche rows now have full geometry/fold/cofactor channel scores.
interpretation.next_action: Compose these train/cal-only scores into an extended OOS surface, then rerun the fixed-threshold confounded proxy audit without changing the threshold.

counterevidence_categories.mechanism_text_review_context_counterevi: Curated review-context counterevidence from mechanism text; review/abstention only and not valid external/orphan safety evidence.
counterevidence_categories.structure_local_evidence_counterevidence: Predictive safety counterevidence from active-site residues, local ligands, pocket descriptors, or compactness.

leakage_policy.review_context_policy: Mechanism text, entry names, labels, EC/Rhea identifiers, and source ids may be carried for review, abstention, or counterevidence provenance, but must not add positive retrieval score.

metadata.scoring: residue and role overlap plus ligand/cofactor context, local PLP ligand-anchor context, substrate-pocket descriptors, and compactness
metadata.validation_boundary: retrieval evidence only; not mechanism validation

predicted_geometry_metadata.active_site_roles_source: M-CSA catalytic residue annotations are retained to isolate coordinate-source degradation; this is not a bare-sequence active-site localization test
predicted_geometry_metadata.source: AlphaFoldDB mmCIF by current702 UniProt accession

scope: Train/cal-only scored extension for the Lever 3 confounded-proxy evidence tranche. It parses the tranche-vs-train-atlas Foldseek TSV, recomputes source-free predicted geometry for the same non-heldout OOS rows, and applies no threshold tuning.
